evidence.source: Adobe's Firefly data and content usage paper states that outputs are customer content, Adobe asserts no intellectual-property rights in them, and outputs may be used in client projects subject to the agreement and restrictions: https://business.adobe.com/content/dam/dx/us/en/resources/sdk/adobe-firefly-data-and-content-usage/adobe-firefly-data-and-content-usage.pdf

Adobe's current Firefly API migration guide identifies Firefly Image Model 5 on the v4 generation endpoint but says the API does not expose explicit model versioning and removes the earlier modelVersion field: https://developer.adobe.com/firefly-services/docs/firefly-api/guides/how-tos/cm-generate-image/breaking-changes

Adobe states that foundational Firefly models are trained on licensed content such as Adobe Stock and public-domain content whose copyright has expired, are not trained on customer content, and do not mine the web for training: https://www.adobe.com/ai/overview/firefly/gen-ai-approach.html

Evaluation approval is limited to the committed project-authored synthetic fixtures. Adobe documents structure and style reference inputs, while its data-usage paper says customer content is not used to train or improve generative AI models: https://developer.adobe.com/firefly-services/docs/firefly-api/guides/concepts/structure-image-reference/ and https://developer.adobe.com/firefly-services/docs/firefly-api/guides/concepts/style-image-reference/ and https://business.adobe.com/content/dam/dx/us/en/resources/sdk/adobe-firefly-data-and-content-usage/adobe-firefly-data-and-content-usage.pdf

Adobe's Firefly Services security fact sheet states that reference content is deleted 24 hours after initial creation and prompt/configuration data plus a pseudonymous user identifier are retained for 90 days: https://www.adobe.com/cc-shared/assets/pdf/trust-center/ungated/whitepapers/creative-cloud/adobe-firefly-services-security-fact-sheet.pdf

blockers: The current Firefly Image Model 5 API does not expose an immutable model snapshot or explicit model version, so the fixed-model reproducibility gate is not satisfied.
Human product/privacy review must explicitly accept the documented 90-day prompt/configuration retention and 24-hour reference-content retention before an evaluation call.
Firefly Services enterprise entitlement, exact evaluation pricing, and current create/revise capability parity must be verified before implementing or invoking an adapter.
